$comment: Preparation-only schema for EXP-CRYPTO-6505c6. Defines the shape a future proof-producing symbolic audit must fill for every obligation/chart certificate and the 20-file aggregate output bundle it must produce. This schema asserts no mathematical result, statement, or verdict; it is a structural contract, not a certificate.
title: EXP-CRYPTO-6505c6 certificate schema (unfilled preparation artifact)

certificate.description: One certificate entry as it must appear, once filled by a future qualified audit, in certificate-bundle.md and be bound by dependency-dag.yaml/checker-results.yaml. Every field below is a structural placeholder; none is populated by this preparation task.

cert_id.description: Unique explicit certificate-ID marker, unique within the 20-file bundle. Not allocated here.

statement.description: Exact mathematical statement the certificate claims to discharge. Null until a future audit states it.

scope.description: Exact (case_id, obligation_id) or (case_id, left_tag, right_tag) key(s), family, base stratum, and parameter locus the statement is claimed over. Must never be broader than what is actually proved.

quantifier.description: Explicit forall/exists structure and order (e.g. 'for every n>=1 and all (Q,R)'), matching specification.frozen_symbolic_domain.quantifiers. A certificate whose quantifier order is weaker than the target's does not discharge the target.

source.description: Exact external or internal source the certificate rests on, in the citation-provenance shape from templates/research-records.md.

anchor.description: Hash or locator binding this certificate's text to a specific materialized artifact (e.g. a byte range in certificate-bundle.md). No anchor is fabricated here; dangling/duplicate anchors must be rejected by the checker.

dependency.description: Other cert_ids this certificate's argument relies on, forming edges of dependency-dag.yaml. Empty array is valid (no dependencies); this is not the same as an unfilled/null field.

status.description: One of the six statuses fixed by specification.obligation_matrix.statuses. Null here means unfilled by this preparation task, not any of the six statuses.

bundle_file.description: One of the 20 fixed aggregate audit output files a future audit must produce under experiments/EXP-CRYPTO-6505c6/audits/<genuinely_allocated_future_audit_TASK_ID>/.

bundle_constraints.obligation_rows_requirement: obligation-results.yaml must contain all 160 (case_id, obligation_id) keys with exact statement, scope, status, certificate anchor and dependency IDs.
bundle_constraints.chart_rows_requirement: chart-coverage.yaml must contain all 400 (case_id, left_tag, right_tag) keys with domain predicates, compatibility/emptiness status and certificate anchor.
bundle_constraints.hash_requirement: Hash every materialized artifact except artifact-sha256.json itself, which the Coordinator archive binds.

soundness_boundary: Schema validity, hash consistency, and coverage completeness (160/400 keys present) are structural properties only. None of them, singly or together, discharges a mathematical premise, proves a statement, or upgrades a null/OPEN status to CERTIFIED. A cert_id with a populated 'source' field but no independent reading/matching record cannot discharge a mathematical premise (specification.independent_checker_plan.soundness_boundary).
